* '''Original''' ([[Artoo (V)]]): Virtual Set 19 release; card image first published 10 August 2022<ref name="img-o-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual19-Light/large/artoo.gif</code> as published 10 August 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/25528d7b73b5e6206de765d700504be693fc39da/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual19-Light/large/artoo.gif holotable commit 25528d7] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114002405/https://swccg.com/snapshots/psa/reflections-first-family-primary-sources-381.html Internet Archive primary-source copy].</ref>: “Once per game, may use 1 Force to shuffle opponent's Reserve Deck or place opponent's just-played Interrupt out of play. * '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC errata of 30 December 2024; card image marked E1 published 30 December 2024, and the current [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Set19Type.html Virtual Set 19 card list]<ref name="img-PC-E1-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual19-Light/large/artoo.gif</code> as published 30 December 2024: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9d2c01ed1603f793dc8a0569c99d4b544378da9b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual19-Light/large/artoo.gif holotable commit 9d2c01e] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114001919/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/9d2c01ed1603f793dc8a0569c99d4b544378da9b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual19-Light/large/artoo.gif Original image at the cited commit].</ref><ref name="cj-PC-E1">Players Committee card data, [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/4da5a9ec5636a391e4113eba01c7463a1b42ba32 swccg-card-json commit 4da5a9ec56] (13 January 2025): dating evidence only. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114002405/https://swccg.com/snapshots/psa/reflections-first-family-primary-sources-381.html Internet Archive primary-source copy].</ref>: “When deployed, may play a Defensive Shield from under your Starting Effect (as if from hand). Once per game, may use 1 Force to place opponent's just-played Interrupt out of play. While with Anakin, C-3PO, or Luke, attrition against you here is -2.” The PC card data's errata note (errataDate 30 December 2024) quotes the original text. '''What changed:''' Rewritten: “When deployed, may play a Defensive Shield from under your Starting Effect (as if from hand).” was added; the once-per-game ability lost its “shuffle opponent's Reserve Deck” option; “If in battle with Anakin or Luke, may draw one destiny and subtract that amount from opponent's attrition.” became “While with Anakin, C-3PO, or Luke, attrition against you here is -2.” Stats unchanged. The card gained the E1 mark.
